lin.name: Flight Console

changes: a greeting picture: a drawn scene or emblem beside or behind the question (a skyline, a radar sweep, a switchboard), light enough to read over
arrows, chevrons and carets redrawn as one family (weight, angle, size) across links, selects and folds
the kind icons redrawn as small badges in each kind's colour

lin.idea: a 1969 flight console: a readout strip across the top (TODAY, PLANS, TO DO, LATE, IDEAS), the coming weeks drawn as a flight plan of hops between stops, an annunciator of lit lamps on Status, a crew board of lamps on To do, a T-minus countdown for setup, a flight-log chat
